gates.rule: selected = candidate with the highest base m=2 pre-tax CAGR among arms passing every gate

gates.G10: instruments: share of delta max DD <= +3.0 pp >= 80%
gates.T1: after-tax $100k > R2 in all three windows

params.instrument: synthetic QLD* daily-reset 2x on QQQ total return, expense 0.95%/yr, financing DTB3 + {base 0.0, calibrated 0.75%/yr}
params.signals: production R2 (equity_leveraged_trend_v1 1.2.0): E2 2-of-3 on price closes (SMA200, 252-session price return > 0, close > 126-session max/min midpoint) + early re-entry at 0.5 x vt while E2 off and close > SMA50, vol20 < its 252-session median and close > close 20 sessions ago; exit early below SMA50
params.sizing: vt = min(1, 0.35/vol20) on synthetic QLD*, cap 0.98, 0.5 pp resize band
